paths.description: Homepage: primary market/news overview and search entry; desktop, mobile, light, dark, reduced-motion and increased-contrast conditions.
AAPL quote/detail archetype representing instrument pages and the core home-to-quote journey.
Finance news listing archetype representing section feeds.
Fresh no-cookie and no-JavaScript discovery path, including robots.txt and sitemap.xml.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt rather than continuity-preserving.
findings.evidence: DOM/performance probe confirms the View Transition API is available, but no active transitions were observed and navigation between the homepage and quote/news documents used ordinary full-document swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions for high-frequency navigation, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Dense desktop chrome competes with primary finance content.
findings.evidence: The 780px desktop screenshot is 4,458px tall and devotes a persistent right rail to repeated tickers, events, portfolio prompts and dock controls while the main feed also includes advertising and large empty/error regions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce duplicate market chrome, defer secondary panels, and keep the primary story/quote task visually dominant.

findings.summary: The quote template has horizontal overflow.
findings.evidence: The quote probe measured scrollWidth 792px at an innerWidth of 780px; the homepage and news templates measured no overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the overflowing fixed/intrinsic width in the quote template with fluid sizing and min-width:0 on grid/flex children.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and control sizing are not consistently perceivable.
findings.evidence: The first focused control in dark mode had a 1px rgb(16,16,16) auto outline against a rgb(20,24,28) page, and desktop probes found 21 controls below 24px in at least one dimension. The mobile market selector is only 18px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a high-contrast :focus-visible ring and bring interactive targets to at least 24x24 CSS px, preferably 44x44 for primary touch controls.

findings.summary: A failed content state provides no recovery action.
findings.evidence: Homepage screenshots show “We’re unable to load stories right now.” under More News, followed by a large empty region, with no Retry or alternate path.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a visible retry action, concise failure context, and retain previously available/stale stories when safe.

findings.summary: The entry page ships a large, script-heavy request graph.
findings.evidence: Raw CDP recorded 330 requests and about 2.95 MB of content-length-labelled responses on the homepage. Large scripts included ~201 KB Google ads, ~170 KB GTM, ~138 KB video player and ~117 KB dock code.
findings.suggestedFix: Delay non-critical ads, analytics, video and dock modules until intent/visibility; split route code and remove duplicate or unused third-party work.

findings.summary: The primary search input lacks a programmatic accessible name in the inspected DOM.
findings.evidence: The mobile DOM probe found the visible 320x32 search INPUT had no aria-label; its placeholder is visible text but is not a durable label.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate a persistent <label> with the search field or provide an accurate aria-label while retaining the placeholder as a hint.

findings.summary: Fresh no-cookie crawlers receive the consent experience instead of finance content.
findings.evidence: The discoverability primitive fetched 111,469 bytes but both browser and no-JS crawler resolved to consent.yahoo.com and saw “Your privacy choices”, not Yahoo Finance content. sitemap.xml also returned HTTP 429 during recon.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve crawlable finance content and metadata to legitimate no-JS crawlers without requiring a consent round trip; publish a stable sitemap endpoint and keep consent controls layered over accessible server content.

findings.summary: Substantial third-party analytics and advertising traffic remains after Reject all.
findings.evidence: After explicitly selecting Reject all, raw CDP still observed 10 third-party origins including Google Ads, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Comscore, Chartbeat and Pushly/CDN services across roughly 330 requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Audit post-rejection requests, block non-essential analytics/ads until affirmative consent, and consolidate or remove vendors that do not support the core task.

findings.summary: Strong transport headers are weakened by permissive script policy and cookie/referrer settings.
findings.evidence: The finance document has HSTS, nosniff, SAMEORIGIN and CSP, but script-src permits unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval; Referrer-Policy is no-referrer-when-downgrade; the PRF cookie was observed without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Move inline code to nonced/hashed scripts, remove unsafe-eval, adopt strict-origin-when-cross-origin or stricter, and mark PRF Secure with an explicit SameSite policy.

findings.summary: Core content does not progressively survive the consent/no-JavaScript path.
findings.evidence: The no-JS crawler and fresh browser both resolved to a consent document whose content tokens are privacy controls rather than finance stories, quotes or navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render essential finance content and links, then progressively enhance; keep consent enforcement from replacing all public content for non-JS clients.

findings.summary: Third-party and media work is disproportionate for the first page view.
findings.evidence: The homepage made about 330 requests for ~2.95 MB and contacted 10 third-party origins; large ad, analytics and video-player scripts load before the user asks to play media.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a page-weight/request budget, lazy-load the player and advertising modules, and reduce analytics vendors and event traffic.

findings.summary: Repeated menu interaction grows listeners, DOM nodes and heap.
findings.evidence: Across 10 menu open/close cycles, Performance.getMetrics increased JSEventListeners by 53, Nodes by 334 and JSHeapUsedSize by 9,622,872 bytes; no documents or frames were added.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile menu mount/unmount ownership, remove listeners/observers on close, reuse DOM where practical, and repeat the test with forced GC/heap snapshots to confirm retained paths.
